data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — infrastructure wiring task. Registers the task-2b hook into the pre-commit framework at the commit-msg stage, mirroring the sprint-trailer-check entry, so the dd-2 HARD-GATE actually fires at commit-msg time. DD-2 behavior is owned by task-2b; this task wires its invocation.)

Add a hook entry to the repo-root .pre-commit-config.yaml local repo, modeled on the existing `sprint-trailer-check` / `pre-commit-ticket-gate` entries: dispatch via pre-commit-wrapper.sh, language: system, pass_filenames: false, stages: [commit-msg]. The entry must invoke plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh. Pure YAML wiring — no conditional logic in the config file itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] .pre-commit-config.yaml is valid YAML — Verify: python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open(".pre-commit-config.yaml"))'
- [ ] The new hook entry references check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh — Verify: grep -q 'check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh' .pre-commit-config.yaml
- [ ] The check-antipattern-scan-trailer hook is registered at the commit-msg stage — Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; hooks=[h for r in yaml.safe_load(open('.pre-commit-config.yaml'))['repos'] for h in r['hooks'] if 'check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh' in h.get('entry','')]; assert hooks and hooks[0].get('stages')==['commit-msg'], hooks"
- [ ] TDD exemption: unit criterion 1 — pure YAML wiring, no conditional logic; the structural python3 assert that stages==['commit-msg'] for the new hook entry is sufficient behavioral verification.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Register check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh at commit-msg stage in .pre-commit-config.yaml
